title: Southridge Beach
wikitext:
[[File:Southridge Beach.jpg|thumb|Southridge Beach]]

'''Southridge Beach''' is located in central [[Azshara]], lining the South edge of the [[Bay of Storms]]. It is heavily inhabited by the [[naga]], but also supports [[makrura]], [[hydra]]s, [[murloc]]s, and the occasional [[sea giant]]. Countless ruins dot the beach, remnants of the once-great city of [[Eldarath]].
